verdict.line: You lose if you let him free-farm to six items of sustain; you win if you punish levels 1-5 before Masochism damage and passive regen take over.

brief.thesis: Camille wins this matchup 51.7% over 149 games because she has a real kill window before Dr. Mundo's Adrenaline Rush passive and Masochism (E) damage spike come online, but that window closes once he's stacked health items and his regen outpaces your poke. Trading into his Q (Infected Cleaver) chip is the central risk since it scales off your max health and threatens you even when you're ahead on CS.

theirWindow.when: Q (Infected Cleaver) is up and you're low HP
theirWindow.what: His Q is a 975-range skillshot on a 4-second cooldown that deals damage based on your max health — he will spam it at you across minions whenever you're exposed, and because it scales off your health it hurts more the tankier you build, so don't facetank it just because you have a shield item.

yourWindow.when: levels 1-5, before his E stacks matter
yourWindow.what: Use Q (Precision Protocol) to proc an empowered auto and walk away, then E (Hookshot) to a wall for the knock-up when he overextends for CS — his Masochism (E) only grants bonus AD based on missing health, so early trades before he's taken much damage are safest for you.

start.why: chosen in 76.9% of these games (53.8% win rate over 143) because the lifesteal and AD let you win short trades without needing to out-sustain his passive regen

boots.why: run in 47.1% of games (56.2% win rate over 73) since his basic attacks and auto-reliant trading are the main source of chip damage you'll be absorbing

core.why: the first item in the 48.1%-pick build path, giving the burst damage and move speed to actually close out trades before his regen ticks it back
second item in both top build paths, adding sustain and AoE wave clear so you can shove and reset against a Teleport-heavy matchup
third item in the highest win-rate path (50% over 50 games), converting his Q poke damage into delayed healing instead of a straight loss

situational.when: his passive regen and Sadism (R) are keeping him alive through your damage
you want faster ability haste for Q resets instead of Death's Dance's defensive stats (58.3% win rate over 24 games with this path)
he's building toward burst threat or you need the tenacity and shield to survive all-ins

runes.keystoneWhy: the 16.9%-pick page (54.8% win rate) gives you sustained health scaling to match a sustain-heavy opponent while still rewarding you for landing autos in trades

summoners.why: the top combo at 57.6% win rate (62.8% pick) because Ignite's healing reduction directly counters his passive regen and Sadism (R), turning your early kill windows into actual kills instead of resets

playing.title: Abuse levels 1-5 all-ins
playing.detail: Open Q (Precision Protocol) into E (Hookshot) off a wall whenever he pushes for CS before level 6 — his Masochism (E) bonus AD is tied to missing health he hasn't lost yet, so these trades are heavily in your favor.

playing.title: Track his Q cooldown before engaging
playing.detail: Infected Cleaver is up every 4 seconds at 975 range and scales off your max health — bait it out or walk behind minions before committing your own cooldowns.

playing.title: Hold Ignite for his all-in or Sadism
playing.detail: Since Sadism (R) trades his health for massive regen and speed, landing Ignite before or during that window denies most of the value he gets from popping it.

playing.title: Don't facetank after level 10
playing.detail: Once his passive regen and item sustain stack up, flat trading stops working — force shorter, burst-heavy engages with Trinity Force procs instead of extended fights.

playing.title: Use Hydra wave clear to deny Teleport flanks
playing.detail: 55.6% of Dr. Mundo players run Teleport-Ignite, so keep the wave pushed with Ravenous Hydra to limit his ability to TP mid and affect other lanes.

playing.title: Buy Executioner's Calling on sustain stalls
playing.detail: If his passive regen and Sadism are keeping him alive through your full combo, the grievous wounds from Executioner's Calling closes that gap directly.

brief.patchCaveat: All items, runes, boots, and summoner spells above are pulled directly from OP.GG's measured Camille-vs-Dr.-Mundo data on the current patch (16.20.1); the power curve, trade windows, and tell are this coach's tactical reading of those numbers against the live ability text.

stats.opponentTip: Stay behind minions to avoid being hit with Dr. Mundo’s cleavers (Q)! Use your passive and purchase items that reduce healing to engage favorably!
